simple.meaning: הִגָּיוֹן (higgâyôwn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a murmuring sound , i.e. a musical notation (probably similar to the modern affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication, a machination.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Psalms, Lamentations, beginning at Psalms 9:17. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הִגָּיוֹן (H1902).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H1902. higgayon הִגָּיוֺן noun masculine resounding music, meditation, musing ; — ׳ה absolute Psa 9:17 ; 92:4 ; construct הֶגְיוֺן Psalm 19:15; suffix הֶגְיוֺנָם Lam 3:62 ; — 1 resounding music ; בְּכִנּוֺר חִגָּיוֺן עֲלֵי Psa 92:4 with sounding music upon the lyre (Che); compare ׳ה סֶ֑לָה 9:17 (a musical direction, see סלה ). 2 meditation, musing לִבִּי וְהֶגְיוֺן אִמְרֵיפִֿי Psalm 19:15 the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart ; also in bad sense = plotting עָלַי וְהֶגְיוֺנָם קָמַי שֹׂפְתֵי Lam 3:62 ; the lips of those rising against me, and their imagining against me (|| מַחְשְׁבֹתָם 3:61 ; compare I. הָגָה 3b ).
